g.title: NewWorld
g.text: New World: progression and economy as flows. What each activity consumes and produces.
Green = faucet, red = sink, orange = gate. Violet / brown / amber bold edges: crafted / dropped / bought gear. [S] sourced, [M] memory, [D] derived.

g.title: cluster_refine
g.text: 2 Refining: 5 skills. Tier N = 2 of tier N-1 + new raws + 1 reagent [S, nwdb]. Every refine now needs only a T2 station [S]

g.title: cluster_craft
g.text: 3 Crafting: 7 skills, 0-200/250 [S]. The screen shows the GS range before you commit [S]

g.title: cluster_drops
g.text: 4 Drop-only keys: crafting cannot make these, loot cannot skip them

g.title: cluster_loadout
g.text: 5 The loadout a player fights in, where it comes from, and the gear score it gives

g.title: A_proj
g.text: company pays to start, all fill;

g.title: G_recipe
g.text: GATE: recipe needs a skill level

g.title: I_chest->R_shed
g.text: adds weight to that town's shed [S]

g.title: R_materia->ST_kiln
g.text: buy the named drop you want [S]

g.title: T_share
g.text: Share of the equipped loadout that was crafted (by someone) [M]/[D]
~20-40%: drops, quests, cheap crafted gear off the post
~40-70%: 590-600 crafted with mods; named drops for unique perks
~half or more, but drop-gated: replicas from materia,
raid gear from raid keys, patterns, prismatic artisan
nwdb lists ~8,100 recipes; ~4,400 turn a drop-only key into a named, raid,
faction or PvP item (replicas, patterns, faction gear) [S/D]. Every tool recipe is Engineering [S].
